mandate: C309 — test the COIN-M inverse cross-sectional premium-index & mark-perp-basis carry family (504 pre-registered configs) on the SAME C307 cache (no re-ingest, no new data, no gate/cost/edge-rule weakening). Multiple-testing (Holm+BH over 504 configs), DSR/MDE given 203 splits, sub-period stability (first vs second half 2022-07..2026-06 and per-year), per-asset attribution over 11 perps, inverse-convexity vs premium/mark-carry decomposition (linear-settlement shadow book), and COIN-M execution-cost-realism overlay (taker 5bps / maker 2bps + 1bps slippage on turnover).

methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs equal-weight B&H (0 bps); Holm step-down and Benjamini-Hochberg step-up over 504 pre-registered configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.stability: split assigned to sub-period by test-window midpoint bar; stable iff exposure>0, net_sum>0, net_mean>B&H and net_mean>0 within the sub-period.
methodology.attribution: per-asset OOS contribution = sum(pos*inv_ret) [inverse-settlement coin PnL]; split into linear shadow-book (premium/mark carry) and convexity = exact - linear.
methodology.inverse_convexity: exact inverse-settlement return 1/entry-1/exit vs linear shadow book (exit-entry)/entry; convexity = exact - linear.
methodology.cost_realism: one-way COIN-M cost on turnover: realistic = taker 5bps + slippage 1bps = 6bps; also reported at taker 5bps and maker 2bps. Native 8h funding excluded (control leg only, never the C309 carry source).
